flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

name: Staravia
flavorText: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

name: Staraptor
flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

attacks.name: Strong Breeze
attacks.text: Your opponent shuffles the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it into his or her deck.

name: Snivy
flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

name: Snivy
flavorText: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

attacks.name: Paralyzing Gaze
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: Serperior
flavorText: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

attacks.name: Leaf Tornado
attacks.text: Move as many Grass Energy attached to your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

abilities.name: Royal Heal
abilities.text: At any times between turns, heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

name: Samurott
flavorText: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.text: Any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Scraggy
flavorText: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

attacks.name: Paralyzing Gaze
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: Solgaleo
flavorText: In writings from the distant past, it's called by the name "the beast that devours the sun."

attacks.name: Solar Geyser
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Rush In
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Max Surfer
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Shining Magikarp
flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

attacks.name: Gold Scale
attacks.text: Your opponent may draw 2 cards. Either way, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Dragon Bond
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card named Gyarados, Dark Gyarados, or Shining Gyarados. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Smeargle
flavorText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

abilities.name: Portrait
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Smeargle is your Active Pokémon, you may look at your opponent's hand. If you do, choose a Supporter card you find there and use the effect of that card as the effect of this power. This power can't be used if Smeargle is affected by a Special Condition.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

attacks.name: Steel Coat
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Metal Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Slowking
flavorText: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Second Sight
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top 3 cards of either player's deck and put them back on top of that player's deck in any order. This power can't be used if Slowking is affected by a Special Condition.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: Its stomach's digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. It can even eat things off the ground.

attacks.name: Layabout
attacks.text: Remove all damage counters from Snorlax. Snorlax can't use Layabout during your next turn.

attacks.name: Clomp Clomp Clobber
attacks.text: Put 1 Energy card attached to Snorlax in the Lost Zone.

name: Seviper
flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

attacks.name: Poison Buildup
attacks.text: Seviper is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Poison Effect
attacks.text: If Seviper is Poisoned, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage and remove the Special Condition Poisoned from Seviper.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

attacks.name: Whismy Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

name: Suicune
flavorText: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

attacks.name: Tsunami
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Extreme Speed
abilities.text: Suicune's Retreat Cost is Colorless less for each Water Energy attached to Suicune.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

name: Slaking
flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

attacks.name: Pitch
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Feint Attack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on that Pokémon.

name: Starly
flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

name: Stunky
flavorText: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

attacks.name: Severe Gas
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Shiftry
flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

attacks.name: Spirit Dance
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

abilities.name: Darkness Fan
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Shiftry is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Evolved Pokémon on your opponent's Bench, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from that Pokémon, and put it back into his or her hand. This power can't be used if Shiftry is affected by a Special Condition.

name: Skuntank
flavorText: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

attacks.name: Frustration
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that doesn't have any damage counters on it. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Toxic Cloud
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.

name: Staraptor
flavorText: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

attacks.name: Accelerative Dive
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all damage done to Staraptor by attacks (both yours and your opponent's) until the end of your next turn.

attacks.name: Brave Heart
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Staraptor does 100 damage to itself.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.

attacks.name: Block
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Ease Up
attacks.text: Snorlax is now Asleep. If Snorlax is evolved from Munchlax, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage.

name: Steelix
flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Metal Slash
attacks.text: Steelix can't attack during your next turn.

name: Seaking
flavorText: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Seaking.

name: Silcoon
flavorText: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, If Silcoon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to Silcoon if that damage is 30 or less.

attacks.name: Entangling String
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

name: Staravia
flavorText: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

name: Seedot
flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

attacks.name: Bide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, if Seedot would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, Seedot is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP becomes 10 instead.

name: Shinx
flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Skorupi
flavorText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a SNORUNT lives there.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Snowball
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

name: Snover
flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

attacks.name: Curiosity
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Snowball Fight
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Snover does 10 damage to itself.

name: Spheal
flavorText: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

attacks.name: Willpower
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your next turn, Spheal's Rollout attack's base damage is 40.

name: Spinarak
flavorText: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.

attacks.name: Impound
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

name: Surskit
flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

attacks.name: Sleep Inducer
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

abilities.name: Skull Stone
abilities.text: During your opponent's turn, if Skull Fossil would be Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, put 1 damage counter on the Attacking Pokémon.

name: Slaking
flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

abilities.name: Energetic Impulse
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Slaking is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, Slaking's Lazy Blow attack's base damage is 130 during this turn. If tails, Slaking can't attack or retreat during this turn. (If Slaking is no longer your Active Pokémon, this effect ends.)

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.

attacks.name: Sidestep
attacks.text: If Bonsly is anywhere under Sudowoodo, flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Sudowoodo during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Persuade
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

name: Sandslash
flavorText: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

attacks.name: Spike Armor
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if Sandslash is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Sandslash is Knocked Out), put 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Spike
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, that Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Sealeo
flavorText: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

attacks.name: Ice Rider
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Shieldon
flavorText: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

attacks.name: Hard Face
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Shieldon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Shield Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage.

name: Sandshrew
flavorText: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

name: Seel
flavorText: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

attacks.name: Freezing Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Plasma
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Shinx.

name: Slakoth
flavorText: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

attacks.name: Drowsy
attacks.text: Both Slakoth and the Defending Pokémon are now Asleep.

name: Sentret
flavorText: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

attacks.name: Grope
attacks.text: Look at the top 2 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

name: Shellder
flavorText: It swims backwards by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

attacks.name: Shell Rest
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from Shellder.

name: Shellos East Sea
flavorText: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

attacks.name: Shell Hunting
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Shellos West Sea and Shellos East Sea and put them on your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Shellos West Sea
flavorText: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard a Water Energy attached to Shellos West Sea and remove all damage counters from Shellos West Sea.

name: Shroomish
flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

attacks.name: Toxic Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Shuckle
flavorText: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.

attacks.name: Ferment Poison
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. As long as the Defending Pokémon remains Poisoned by this attack, it can't use any Poké-Body.

abilities.name: Pot Shell
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Shuckle by your opponent's Pokémon that has any Special Energy cards attached to it.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

attacks.name: Gossip
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Spinda
flavorText: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

attacks.name: Dish Out
attacks.text: Draw a card from the top and the bottom of your deck.

attacks.name: Synchro Punch
attacks.text: If any basic Energy card attached to Spinda is the same type as any Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage.

name: Squirtle
flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Aqua Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Water Energy attached to Squirtle. This attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

name: Stantler
flavorText: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Frighten Horn
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon isn't an Evolved Pokémon, that Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Sunkern
flavorText: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.

attacks.name: Sun Soak
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from Sunkern, search your deck for an Evolution card that evolves from Sunkern, and put it onto Sunkern. (This counts as evolving Sunkern.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Salamence
flavorText: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changes, and wings grew out.

attacks.name: Direct Hit
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Finish
attacks.text: Discard 2 basic Fire Energy cards or 2 basic Water Energy cards attached to Salamence. If you discarded 2 basic Fire Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to the Defending Pokémon. If you discarded 2 Basic Water Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (If you can't discard cards, this attack does nothing.)

name: Suicune
flavorText: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

attacks.name: Cure Stream
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

abilities.name: Aqua Recover
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Suicune from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your discard pile for up to 3 Water Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand.

name: Sharpedo
flavorText: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as "The Bully of the Sea."

attacks.name: Strike Wound
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has 2 or more damage counters on it, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage. This attack damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on that Pokémon.

abilities.name: Rough Skin
abilities.text: If Sharpedo is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Sharpedo is Knocked Out), put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

name: Sunflora
flavorText: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

attacks.name: Petal Dance
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, Sunflora is now Confused.

abilities.name: Grass Whistle
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove 1 damage counter from each of your Grass Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Grass Whistle Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Sunflora is affected by a Special Condition.

name: Sableye
flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

attacks.name: Rummage
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Choose as many Trainer cards as you like, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Put the other cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Shadow Sneak
attacks.text: If you and your opponent have a different number of Prize cards left, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.

name: Shelgon
flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.text: During your next turn, Shelgon's Protect Charge attack's base damage is 80.

attacks.name: Protect Charge
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Shelgon by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Skiploom
flavorText: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

attacks.name: U-turn
attacks.text: Switch Skiploom with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Cotton Balloon
abilities.text: If Skiploom has any Grass Energy attached to it, any damage done to Skiploom by attacks from your opponent's Evolved Pokémon is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Smeargle
flavorText: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.

attacks.name: Color Pick
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Trace
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose an attack on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Trace copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else required for that attack.) Smeargle performs that attack.

name: Smoochum
flavorText: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

attacks.name: Psykiss
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Special Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Jynx from your hand onto Smoochum (this counts as evolving Smoochum) and remove all damage counters from Smoochum.

name: Slowking
flavorText: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

attacks.name: Psych Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, Slowking's Psych Up attack's base damage is 60.

abilities.name: Trump Card
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Slowking is affected by a Special Condition.

name: Seviper
flavorText: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.

attacks.name: Tail Blade
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Poison Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.

attacks.name: Air Crash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Steel Wing
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Skarmory by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Slowbro
flavorText: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

name: Sceptile
flavorText: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

attacks.name: Leaf Blade
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage.

abilities.name: Wild Growth
abilities.text: Each basic Grass Energy card attached to your Grass Pokémon provides GrassGrass Energy instead. You can't use more than 1 Wild Growth Poké-Body each turn.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: Remove all Special Conditions and 3 damage counters from Slowpoke. Slowpoke is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Tumble Over
attacks.text: Slowpoke can't attack during your next turn.

name: Slugma
flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

name: Solrock
flavorText: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.

attacks.name: Sol Charge
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Sunlight
abilities.text: If you have Lunatone in play, damage done to your opponent's Pokémon by your Psychic or Fighting Pokémon isn't affected by resistance.

name: Swablu
flavorText: Its wings are like cotton tufts. If it perches on someone's head, it looks like a cotton hat.

attacks.name: Super Speed
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Swablu during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Shoot Through
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Swampert
flavorText: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card from your opponent's deck.

abilities.name: Wash Out
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Water or Fighting Energy attached to 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Swampert is affected by a Special Condition.

name: Scizor
flavorText: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

attacks.name: Special Blow

attacks.name: Controlled Burn

name: Steelix

name: Suicune

name: Stantler

name: Shuckle
flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

attacks.name: Toxic Saliva
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

abilities.text: Whenever an attack (including your own) does 40 or less damage to Shuckle (after applying Weakness and Resistance), reduce that damage to 10. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) This power stops working while Shuckle is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

name: Skiploom
flavorText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

attacks.name: Mysterious Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Slugma

name: Smoochum

name: Snubbull

name: Shining Gyarados
flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Shining Gyarados. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Devastate
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy cards attached to Shining Gyarados or this attack does nothing. This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Then, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it and discard those Energy cards.

name: Shining Magikarp
flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

attacks.name: Gold Scale
attacks.text: Your opponent may draw 2 cards. Either way, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Dragon Bond
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card named Gyarados, Dark Gyarados, or Shining Gyarados. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Shining Celebi
flavorText: It is worshipped as a god of the forest. It appears only in undisturbed old-growth forests.

attacks.name: Healing Water
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon equal to the number of Water Energy cards attached to Shining Celebi. If the Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Miracle Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. If you get 1 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep, Confused, or Poisoned (your choice).

name: Shining Charizard
flavorText: The flames it breathes are so hot that they can melt anything.

attacks.name: White-hot Flame
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card and 1 Lightning Energy card attached to Shining Charizard or this attack does nothing. Flip a coin. If tails, Shining Charizard does 30 damage to itself.

name: Shining Kabutops
flavorText: This ancient Pokémon uses its razor-sharp claws to cut open its prey and gain access to its blood.

attacks.name: Lightning Cut
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage and does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does 30 damage and Shining Kabutops does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Water Slash
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Shining Kabutops but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Don't apply Resistance.

name: Shining Mewtwo
flavorText: It uses its highly developed psychic powers to defeat its enemies before they even have time to think.

attacks.name: Reflect Shield
attacks.text: If an attack does damage to Shining Mewtwo during your opponent's next turn (even if Shining Mewtwo is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Shining Mewtwo from that attack (any other effects of attacks still happen) and do 20 damage to the attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psyburst
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy card attached to Shining Mewtwo or this attack does nothing. This attack does 40 damage plus 10 damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

name: Shining Noctowl
flavorText: It speeds up its thought processes by turning its head around 180 degrees.

attacks.name: Flashing Eyes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If exactly 1 is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If exactly 2 are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If all 3 are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: Shining Raichu

attacks.name: Thundersquall
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon for each Water Energy attached to Shining Raichu. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Shining Steelix
flavorText: If an Onix lives 100 years or more, its skin hardens, eventually becoming even harder than a diamond.

attacks.name: Crushing Earth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, Shining Steelix can't attack during your next turn.

name: Shining Tyranitar
flavorText: It is so powerful, it can knock down a mountain with hust one arm.

attacks.name: Mountain Crush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, your opponent discards the top card from his or her deck.

attacks.name: Destructive Fire
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Fire Energy card attached to Shining Tyranitar. For each heads, discard a Fire Energy card attached to Shining Tyranitar or this attack does nothing. Then, for each heads, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and discard it. If it has fewer Energy cards than that, remove all of them.

name: Scyther
flavorText: It moves so fast as to be invisible to the naked eye. Even when standing still, its camouflage prevents it from being seen.

attacks.name: Agility
